apps.label: Any Android TV app
notes: Android TV is driven by the D-pad: focus moves to the nearest focusable element in the pressed direction; OK selects the focused element.
Most apps: a left navigation rail (Home, Search, Movies, Shows, My List, Settings) and horizontal rows of tiles stacked vertically.
Prefer a deep link or the app's search over browsing. Always check which element has the focus highlight before pressing OK.
BACK closes overlays/dialogs and goes up one screen; on a home screen BACK usually opens the rail or an exit dialog - never confirm Exit.

when: are you sure you want to exit

dialogs.only_if: user asked to skip or rule skip_intro

home.looks: Hero/billboard at the top, then horizontal rows of posters; optional left rail of icons that expands to labels when focused.
home.focus: UP/DOWN moves between rows (the row scrolls into view, focus keeps its column); LEFT/RIGHT moves along a row; LEFT from the first tile enters the rail; RIGHT from the rail returns to content.

search.looks: A text box with either the system keyboard (IME) or the app's own letter grid (a-z, 0-9, space, delete); results appear beside or below.
search.focus: Grid keyboards: D-pad moves between letter keys, OK types. With the system IME: text can be typed directly. After typing, results are RIGHT of a left-side keyboard or BELOW a top keyboard.

detail.looks: Big backdrop, the title (or its logo), metadata, a row of buttons (Play/Resume, Trailer, Add to list), episodes/seasons and 'More like this' below.
detail.focus: Focus starts on the primary button (Play/Resume). DOWN goes to Episodes/Seasons, then 'More like this'.

episodes.looks: A season selector (tabs, dropdown or a vertical list on the left) and a list of episodes with numbers/thumbnails.
episodes.focus: Season tabs: LEFT/RIGHT; season lists: UP/DOWN on the left then RIGHT into episodes. Episodes scroll as focus moves. OK on an episode plays it.

player.looks: Full-screen video. An overlay (title, seek bar, Pause, Subtitles, Next episode) appears on OK/DOWN and hides after a few seconds.
player.focus: PLAY_PAUSE toggles; LEFT/RIGHT seek when the bar shows; BACK leaves the player. 'Skip Intro'/'Next Episode' buttons take focus by themselves when shown.

profile.looks: 'Who's watching?' with round or square avatars in a row.
profile.focus: LEFT/RIGHT between avatars; the last used profile is usually focused already; OK selects.

login.looks: Sign-in / phone number / QR code / activation code.
login.focus: Cannot be completed by TV Pilot - tell the user to sign in.

dialog.looks: A small centered box with 1-3 buttons.
dialog.focus: LEFT/RIGHT or UP/DOWN between buttons; OK presses.

ask_user_when: the title exists in several installed apps and none was named
several different titles match (e.g. a show and a movie with the same name)
a profile must be chosen and no default profile is set
the app needs sign-in or a subscription
